extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators (especially new or unregistered users)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who encounter a missing-Wikipedia-page notice and steps/requirements to create, locate, or recover an article. Covers account requirements, searching for existing content, redirects, deletion checks, and procedural options (article wizard/draft/request).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page, log in or register and wait until your account is autoconfirmed (automatic after meeting site conditions). Alternatives include using the article wizard, submitting a draft for review, or requesting a new article if you cannot create it directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard / submit a draft / request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not ready to create a live article or lack permissions, use the article wizard to prepare a draft, submit the draft for review by experienced editors, or post a request (e.g., at Articles for Creation) asking others to create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles and alternative spellings/titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "30 Rock pulled episodes" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check for alternative titles, spellings, or existing coverage elsewhere on Wikipedia; use the search box and examine pages that might already cover the topic to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what links here / find incoming links
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'What links here' tool to discover references or redirects to the desired title; that can reveal whether the topic is covered under another page or previously linked and deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page visibility delay and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a recently created page does not appear, allow time for database updates and try purging the page cache (reload with purge) before concluding it is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and possible alternate title forms; if the desired title differs only by capitalization or minor variation, create or request a redirect to the correct canonical page rather than a separate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log and reasons for deletion
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect deletion, consult the deletion log and related help pages to learn why a page was removed and whether recreation is appropriate or requires addressing deletion reasons (notability, sourcing, copyright, etc.).
